rows.name: Class timetable detective
steps: Give each pair the school timetable and an analogue clock face.
Pairs find when a named lesson starts and show it on the clock.
Say am or pm for the time.
Given the start and the length of a lesson, find when it ends.
Find the gap between two lessons.

levels.0: Clock face shows no time for the lesson.
levels.1: Start time is shown but am or pm is left off.
levels.2: Start time is set on the clock face with am or pm, and the end time is found.
levels.3: Gap between two lessons is written in minutes.

rows.note: INFERRED from unit topics; no document or educator plan describes this activity, so steps are suggested, not the school's. Unit bullets: Reading analogue/digital clocks; Understanding am/pm; Reading timetables.

rows.name: Class survey
steps: Choose a question such as favourite fruit.
Draw a pictogram or bar chart.
Say the largest and smallest group.

levels.1: Tallies are made but the chart bars do not match them.
levels.2: Chart bars match the tallies and the largest and smallest groups are named.
levels.3: Second survey question is charted and compared with the first.
